title: Study Groups
statement: A class has n students, numbered 0 to n − 1. Each pair in `pairs` means two students study together, and anyone who studies with someone in a group belongs to that group too. A student who studies with nobody is a group alone. Return the number of study groups.

keyPoints: Build an adjacency list with both directions
Loop over all n students, not only those in pairs
Each unvisited student starts a new group; BFS or DFS marks the whole group
edgeCases: Students who appear in no pair
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Union-find: nearly O(V + E) as well

hints: A study group is a connected component of the graph of students and pairs.
Count how many times you have to start a new search to visit every student.
Loop over all students 0 to n − 1; each unvisited one is a new group, and a search from it marks the rest of the group.
